# SoraCheckboxGroup

A labelled group of checkboxes bound to an array of typed values.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { SoraCheckboxGroup } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraCheckboxGroup from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraCheckboxGroup'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraCheckboxGroup.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraCheckboxGroup.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends string \| number` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` **(required)** | `readonly SoraOption<TValue>[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Group label, rendered as the `<legend>`. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `error` | `string \| readonly string[] \| null` |  | Error message(s). A non-empty value also marks the control invalid and is announced with it. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the required marker. "At least one" must be enforced by validation. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`) without showing a message. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `orientation` | `SoraOrientation` | `'vertical'` | Layout direction. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Native `name` shared by the checkboxes (form submission). |
| `controlAttrs` | `SoraControlAttrs` |  | Applied to every native checkbox; `ref` is called once per checkbox. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `readonly TValue[] \| null` | required | Selected values. `null`/`undefined` are treated as none; updates keep option order. |

| `hint` |  |  |

## Attributes

The `<fieldset>` root. `controlAttrs` is applied to every native checkbox.

## Keyboard

- Tab moves between checkboxes; Space toggles (native).

## Accessibility

- `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`; hint and error describe the group.
- A disabled group disables the fieldset natively.

## Styling

- `.sora-field`, `.sora-field__label`, `.sora-field__hint`, `.sora-field__error`
- `.sora-option-list`, `.sora-check`
- `data-orientation`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<SoraCheckboxGroup
  v-model="channels"
  :options="channelOptions"
  :label="t('demo.notifications')"
  orientation="horizontal"
/>
<p class="mt-2 text-sora-sm text-sora-muted">{{ t('demo.selected', { value: channels.join(', ') }) }}</p>
```
